SPINR RIDER — App Store, iPhone 6.7" · 1290 × 2796

Order follows the actual ride flow (book → price → track → pay → safety),
which is how Lyft sequences theirs. Apple only shows the first 2 or 3 in
search results, so those carry the pitch: who we are, then upfront pricing.

The red route line is continuous across all five frames — frame 1 exits
right at the same height frame 2 enters left, and so on. Swiping the
gallery reads as one panorama. If you reorder the set, the hand-off
heights need reordering with it (ye / yx in _build.py).

SAMPLE DATA — swap before submitting.
Fares ($22.99 and its line items are internally consistent), Saskatoon
addresses, "Sam R.", plate 4WX 812, Visa 4242, ratings and driver counts.
Vehicle tiers (Standard / XL / Accessible) are placeholders too — the real
ones are admin-managed rows in vehicle_types.

STILL TO DO
• Google Play needs its own 1080 × 1920 set — Play rejects anything
  taller than 9:16, so these cannot be reused there.
• Spinr Driver is a separate listing and needs its own set.

Say the word and I'll build both in this same system.
